description: R-SQL-1 SQL-B, SQL-REL: What output Field names, types and SourceTable/SourceField does ACE give for star expansion over a join, two aliases of one table, a repeated column, unnamed expressions, and an empty result (WHERE 1 = 0, with BOF/EOF read at open)? Runs on a fresh copy of r-sql-1-accdb-main opened read-only through ACE DAO; each statement is opened with Database.OpenRecordset as a snapshot unless stated, Fields Name/Type/Size/SourceTable/SourceField are read before the first row, then every row's Field values to EOF (each MoveNext captured), then Close and DBEngine.Errors.
